variants.headline: Still in view: party leader faces a public scandal
variants.sub: A party leader is the subject of a newly revealed scandal.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A scandal concerning a party leader has come to light in {colony}.

In our judgment, {target} does not deserve confidence in this matter. Political trust requires a demanding standard, and the scandal is an appropriate occasion for a distinctly critical assessment.
